subject: Private deployment: coordinated version rollout & rollback window
messages:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ops-team@acme-analytics.com, devops_lead@acme-analytics.com, priyom_das@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment: coordinated version rollout & rollback window

Hi all,

Following our brief last week, I want to kick off the upgrade coordination for your Private deployment (control plane + runtime). Primary goals: keep the customer production API online, minimize token-serving regressions, and ensure a fast, tested rollback path if we see quality or latency degradations.

Key asks from Redwood:
- Confirmation of a 3-hour maintenance window (we propose 2026-05-20 02:00-05:00 UTC) when you can accept brief node drains.
- Final list of firewall / peering rules that need to be adjusted during the rollout.
- Confirmation of the on-prem network team member who will be on the call.

Planned approach (high level):
1) Pre-stage new control-plane + runtime images to canary pool.
2) Canary traffic shaping for 10% of production for 30m with health metrics gating.
3) Gradual rolling upgrade across clusters with KV-cache warmup.
4) If any gating threshold trips, automatic abort + stepwise rollback.

I've attached a draft timeline and the staging network diagram for your infra team to review (draft_rollout_timeline.xlsx, staging-network-diagram.png).

Please reply with conflicts or approvals by EOD 2026-05-14 so we can lock the window and publish the runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: draft_rollout_timeline.xlsx (Excel), staging-network-diagram.png (PNG)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Private deployment: coordinated version rollout & rollback window

On 2026-05-12 08:14, marissa_cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> Following our brief last week, I want to kick off the upgrade coordination for your Private deployment...

Thanks Marissa — I've sketched a technical runbook and attached the first draft (upgrade-runbook-v1.pdf). A few technical notes / requests:

- Version pinning: control-plane (v2.3.1), runtime (v1.8.0-q8), sidecars (v0.9.4). These combinations have been validated in staging; mixing runtime patches without control-plane compatibility causes session-mismatch errors.
- DB/migrations: there are no schema migrations for this release; config defaults are additive. Still, we will snapshot local config and export KV cache before node drain.
- Health gating: latency p90 <= baseline * 1.25 and error-rate <= baseline + 0.2% over 5-minute windows for canary to proceed.
- Network changes: we will only need outbound access to s3.redwood.ai:443 for image pulls and an ephemeral SSH range when we need to debug nodes. Please confirm IPs can reach outbound 52.34.18.9/32 and 3.120.45.7/32 for the window.

Suggested maintenance breakdown (per-cluster):
- Pre-stage images: 30m
- Canary (10% traffic): 30m
- Roll (sequential groups): ~90–120m
- Post-checks & warmups: 20–30m

If the customer can confirm the outbound IPs and a NOC contact, we can finalize the runbook and add scripted rollback steps.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: upgrade-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF)
From: ops-team@acme-analytics.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, devops_lead@acme-analytics.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: coordinated version rollout & rollback window

Marissa / Priyom — thanks for the notes. A couple items from our side: 

- Network ops flagged scheduled firmware updates on our aggregation switches the week of 2026-05-18. We can delay those but want to avoid overlapping maintenance. Can you move the window to 2026-05-21 03:00-06:00 UTC instead?
- Our security team requires that any outbound IPs be whitelisted at least 48 hours in advance. Can you confirm the final list 2026-05-19 EOD?
- Rollback: please provide step-by-step artifact-tagging to revert nodes to the previous runtime image. We also need any database/config snapshots stored in an S3 bucket we control.

Also, what is the expected impact to running LLM sessions if we abort at canary? Do sessions persist to the previous version or will there be token duplication?

—ACME Ops (ops-team@acme-analytics.com)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: ops-team@acme-analytics.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: coordinated version rollout & rollback window

On 2026-05-12 14:37, ops-team@acme-analytics.com wrote:
> Network ops flagged scheduled firmware updates on our aggregation switches...

Hi — small clarifications from the engineering side:

- Impact on sessions: if we abort during canary, new requests after the abort will be routed back to the previous runtime pool. In-flight requests that have already consumed tokens on the new runtime may finish (we mark them as best-effort); we will not double-increment billing tokens because our gateway reconciles token accounting with session ids.
- Rollback steps (short):
  1) Trigger grace-evict for canary pool.
  2) Redeploy nodes with previous image tag (v1.7.9) from your stored artifacts.
  3) Clear KV cache warmup for nodes on rollback and rehydrate from snapshot.
  4) Run smoke tests for p95 latency and end-to-end inference correctness.

We can add a pre-stage step where Redwood performs a dry-run of the image pull + smoke test in your staging cluster 48–72 hours prior. That will also give your network team time to validate IP whitelisting.

Grace O'Connor
Engineering Manager, Customer Reliability
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: FINAL: Private deployment upgrade — confirmed window + runbook link

Team — thanks for the quick responses. Per the switch team's constraint we've moved the window as requested. Final schedule: 2026-05-21 03:00-06:00 UTC. Please confirm your on-call person for the 03:00 UTC start.

What we finalized:
- Version pin: control-plane v2.3.1, runtime v1.8.0-q8 (no mixed-version rollouts).
- Canary: 10% traffic for 30m, gating thresholds (p90 <= baseline * 1.25, error-rate <= baseline + 0.2%).
- Rollback: explicit artifact tag revert to v1.7.9, KV snapshot rehydrate. See attached rollback-checklist.md for exact CLI steps.
- Pre-stage: Redwood to run image-pull + smoke-test in your staging cluster on 2026-05-19 14:00 UTC (we will provide IPs by 2026-05-18 14:00 UTC).

Attachments: runbook-final.pdf (full runbook), rollback-checklist.md (step checklist).
Related: SUP-4527 (linked).

Action items for Acme Ops:
- Confirm NOC contact and phone for 03:00 UTC.
- Whitelist outbound IPs: 52.34.18.9/32 and 3.120.45.7/32 by 2026-05-19 14:00 UTC.

Nikhil — can you approve the SLA exception for the 3-hour window and confirm we can run the pre-stage tests in Acme staging?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
